The Central US Market

Why pre-construction documentation matters here.

Chicago and Dallas are home to the headquarters of many of the largest QSR operators, franchise groups, and retail chains in the country. The decisions about national remodel programmes, portfolio-wide rebrands, and multi-site capital investments are made in these cities — and the documentation standard that supports those decisions is set here. When a programme director in Chicago briefs a 200-location QSR remodel or a VP of Construction in Dallas launches a national retail refresh, the pre-construction documentation must be consistent, structured, and complete enough to serve the entire programme.

The Central US also presents a distinct documentation challenge rooted in climate. The region experiences the widest temperature range of any in the country — from sub-zero winters in Minneapolis and Chicago to sustained triple-digit heat in Dallas and Houston. HVAC systems work harder here than anywhere else, and building envelope performance is critical. FLIR thermal imaging is particularly valuable in this region: it reveals HVAC performance anomalies, identifies insulation failure in the building envelope, and documents the hidden effects of severe thermal cycling on building systems and structure.

Beyond the metros, the Central US drives significant industrial and warehouse conversion activity across the Midwest, large-format retail and big-box renovation in Texas, and energy sector facility documentation in Houston. Each of these project types requires pre-construction documentation that goes beyond a floor plan — complete conditions intelligence that prevents the scope surprises that generate change orders.

The Deliverable

Structured site intelligence. Every project.

Every AlturaScope site visit in the Central US produces the same structured deliverable package — whether the project is a single warehouse conversion in Chicago or a 150-location franchise remodel programme managed from Dallas.

Navigable Digital Twin

Matterport-based 3D model of the entire space. Remote access for the full project team. Measurements taken directly in the model.

Conditions Report

P1/P2/P3 prioritised assessment of existing conditions — structural, MEP, finishes, building envelope, code compliance, accessibility.

Equipment & Asset Schedule

Full inventory by location, make, model, condition, and services connections. Formatted for procurement and design teams.

Thermal Imaging (FLIR)

HVAC performance assessment, building envelope analysis, insulation verification, and hidden services identification — critical in extreme climate zones.

Above-Ceiling MEP Documentation

Thermal, pole-mounted 360°, and borescope capture of ceiling plenum conditions, services routing, and conflicts.

ScopeWalk Platform

All deliverables structured in a single portal. Permanent access. For multi-site programmes: compare locations side by side.

Sectors

Markets we serve in the Central US.

QSR & Restaurant

Chicago and Dallas are the decision-making cities for many of the country's largest QSR and franchise programmes. Programme directors in these headquarters manage remodel rollouts that span dozens of states — and they need documentation that is consistent across every location. Our QSR restaurant survey programme delivers the same structured package at every restaurant, managed centrally and accessible through a single ScopeWalk portal.

Retail & Franchise

Large-format retail and big-box renovation programmes in Texas and across the Sun Belt. National rebrands managed from Central US headquarters. Franchise refreshes across the Midwest. Our retail rollout documentation delivers consistent conditions data, equipment inventories, and thermal analysis at every store — so your design and construction teams work from reliable information regardless of the location or store format.

Our healthcare facility survey methodology documents the complex MEP infrastructure, compliance-relevant conditions, and equipment inventories that capital planning teams need to prioritise projects and allocate budget across the network.

Industrial, Energy & Commercial

Logistics

No local subcontractors. No variability.

AlturaScope operates under a national travel model. Every site visit in the Central US — whether it is in downtown Chicago, suburban Dallas, or rural Iowa — is conducted by AlturaScope using the same methodology, the same equipment, and the same deliverable standard. There is no local subcontractor lottery. Travel costs are included in all project pricing.

For multi-site programmes running across the Central US — or across the entire country — we coordinate scheduling centrally. Your team briefs us once, and we manage access, timing, and logistics directly with each location. For programmes requiring simultaneous coverage across multiple states, we mobilise in parallel to compress your pre-construction timeline.

Common questions about Central US site surveys.

Do you cover all states in the Central US? +

Yes. We operate across every state in the Central US — Illinois, Texas, Colorado, Minnesota, Wisconsin, Iowa, Missouri, Kansas, Nebraska, Oklahoma, Ohio, Indiana, Michigan, and beyond. Travel is included in all project pricing. There are no per-visit travel surcharges and no local subcontractors. AlturaScope methodology, AlturaScope deliverables, every time.

Why is HVAC and building envelope documentation particularly important in the Central US? +

The Central US experiences the widest climate range of any region — extreme cold in the upper Midwest, extreme heat in Texas, and everything in between. HVAC systems work harder here than in any other region, and building envelope performance is critical to energy efficiency and occupant comfort. Our FLIR thermal imaging documents HVAC performance anomalies, identifies insulation gaps in the building envelope, and reveals hidden moisture issues that can develop where thermal cycling is severe. For renovation projects, understanding the actual condition of these systems — not just their nameplate data — prevents the change orders that arise when ageing infrastructure fails to meet design assumptions.

Can you support national QSR programmes headquartered in Chicago or Dallas? +

Yes. Chicago and Dallas are home to many of the largest QSR and franchise operators in the country, and we work with programme teams based in these cities to document locations nationwide. We operate under a national travel model — your team briefs us once at headquarters, we calibrate the deliverable during a pilot phase, and then we execute consistently across every location in the programme regardless of state or region. All deliverables are accessible through a single ScopeWalk programme portal.

What types of projects do you document in the Central US? +

Our Central US work includes QSR and franchise remodel programmes managed from Chicago and Dallas headquarters. Large-format retail and big-box renovation in Texas and across the Sun Belt. Industrial and warehouse conversion projects in the Midwest. Energy sector facility documentation in Houston. Healthcare facility surveys for regional health systems. Commercial renovation projects where extreme climate conditions make thorough HVAC and building envelope assessment especially valuable.
